scope: Cross-cutting navigation, shared UI, dashboard, analytics, reports, auth and recovery; source review at da46203.

coverage.flow: Sign in → authorized landing → menu/search → list → form/detail → next action
strengths: Permission-aware menu and route guards already exist.
Ctrl/Cmd+K, keyboard navigation, focus trapping and focus restoration exist.
Brand tokens, shared controls, loading skeletons and empty states exist.
improvements: Role-based Today workspace and pinned/recent tasks.
Remote searchable selectors for large catalogs.
Consistent draft recovery and task-specific responsive layouts.

coverage.flow: Date filter → KPI/alert → domain report → affected record/action
strengths: URL-backed filters, debounced requests and individual widget retry.
Charts are lazy-loaded; loading/error/empty states are separate.
improvements: Put today's pending work and primary role action above analytics.
Turn alert rows into permission-aware record links and preserve date/filter context.
Route GST alerts to the relevant GST screen instead of generic Settings.

coverage.flow: Domain/report → period/entity filters → server results/totals → drilldown/export
strengths: 43 registry definitions across seven groups; production operational reports are additional, outside this count.
Permission-aware discovery/export, URL filters, sort/pagination and generated timestamps.
Export progress and controlled full-result fallback exist.
improvements: Remote search all lookup records instead of first 200.
Named saved views and favorites built on existing shareable filters.
User-selected columns and record drilldowns without losing filter context.

coverage.flow: Choose analysis period → read permitted source snapshots → inspect record tables → open source module
strengths: Shows source access, partial availability, fetched timestamp and stale snapshot warning.
Bounds complete-list reads; does not turn a first page into a full executive total.
Search scope explains that record tables filter while period KPIs stay complete.
improvements: Simpler business-facing names and a clear 'what should I do next' action.
Keep Dashboard for daily work and Deep Dive for optional analysis.
Preserve source period/filters when moving into operational screens.

coverage.flow: Sign in / reset via email → authorized destination; denied/missing screen → permitted recovery destination
strengths: Password visibility toggle, autocomplete, schema validation and submitting states.
Remembered/session-only login and authorized return-route handling.
improvements: Normal reset link should carry the token without exposing an editable technical field.
Persistent contextual server errors, expired-link recovery and request-new-link action.
Associate validation messages with inputs consistently using aria-invalid/describedby.

findings.title: Ordinary-role production shortcuts reuse the same label and ID
findings.problem: With a normal user granted Manufacturing.Orders, Orders, Planning and Import & Reconciliation all render as Production Orders with ID 990 in a source-level reproduction. Daily and Kanban retain their distinct presentation.
findings.impact: Operator cannot reliably distinguish three destinations; duplicate sibling keys can also destabilize rendering.
findings.recommendation: Keep each alias module's label/ID/sort while reusing its permission target. Extend the existing menu test to cover all five destinations.
findings.verification: Executed real buildMenuTree via Vite SSR with an AuthLoginPagePermissionDto-shaped synthetic grant; no API/DB call.

findings.title: Report entity selectors stop at the first 200 records
findings.problem: ReportFilterBar loads categories, expense categories, items, parties, units and admin wallets with PageNumber 1/PageSize 200; the common AppSelect displays only supplied options.
findings.impact: A valid record outside the loaded page cannot be selected by this filter UI.
findings.recommendation: Use searchable server-backed lookup controls, preserve selected values, show loading/retry and support all catalog pages.

findings.title: Add a role-based Today workspace
findings.problem: The system exposes many domain pages and analytics views. Existing permission filtering controls access but does not prioritize the operator's most frequent tasks.
findings.impact: New users must learn module structure before completing routine work.
findings.recommendation: Offer role workspaces for Production, Purchase/Stores, Sales/Dispatch, Accounts and HR; show 4–6 frequent tasks, pending counts and pinned/recent destinations, with all authorized modules still reachable.

findings.title: Extend the shared selector for large lists
findings.problem: AppSelect has keyboard/listbox behavior and inline-create support, but no searchable-input or remote-query contract; finding a record depends on navigating the supplied list.
findings.impact: Large item/party/employee catalogs slow daily entry.
findings.recommendation: Keep the simple selector for small enums; add a common searchable lookup with code+name, recent choices, remote pagination and permission-aware inline create.

findings.title: Make the dashboard action-first
findings.problem: Analytics Overview renders KPI cards and two chart rows before alerts. Alert preview rows are plain text with one View all link per bucket; the GST bucket points to /settings.
findings.impact: Daily operators scan analytics before seeing exceptions and then must find the affected record.
findings.recommendation: Prioritize pending/overdue/blocked work for the user's role; link each alert to the affected permitted record with the active period, and send GST alerts to the matching compliance page.

findings.title: Add reusable report views on top of existing URL filters
findings.problem: Reports already support searching the catalog, period/entity filtering, URL sharing, sorting, pagination and exports. Named favorite views and user-selected columns are not exposed in the reviewed report shell.
findings.impact: Regular reporting requires repeating the same selections and navigating many report cards.
findings.recommendation: Add Save view, favorites, column choice and contextual document drilldown; distinguish full-period totals from page rows and keep existing export safeguards.

findings.title: Use task-specific table density and narrow-screen layouts
findings.problem: Shared tables default to a 760px minimum width and report tables to 920px; horizontal scrolling is the current fallback.
findings.impact: On small screens, primary identity/status/action can be separated by a long horizontal scroll.
findings.recommendation: Keep grids for rapid numeric entry; pin identity/actions, offer sensible columns and compact/comfortable spacing, and use mobile summary cards for approvals/work lists where helpful.
findings.verification: Source layout review only; no claim of measured viewport overflow or accessibility compliance.

findings.title: Simplify password recovery and expose contextual errors
findings.problem: Reset password exposes an editable Reset Token field; API errors in auth forms are primarily transient toast messages. Login validation text is not explicitly associated by aria-describedby/aria-invalid.
findings.impact: Nontechnical users encounter an implementation field and can miss error context.
findings.recommendation: Read token from the email link, show a clear expired/invalid-link recovery action, retain server errors beside the form and connect field messages programmatically.

findings.title: Use business language and consistent next-step guidance
findings.problem: Navigation empty state says RBAC pages from the API will appear here, while analytics titles include Telemetry, Statutory Intelligence and Cross-Module Intelligence.
findings.impact: The interface asks ordinary operators to understand internal terminology.
findings.recommendation: Use client terms such as Today's Production, Pending Payments and GST Status; add optional concise Gujarati/Hinglish help where the client needs it, with one clear recovery/next action.

limitations: Source/configuration/route and selected pure-function review only; no live SQL or real user journey executed.
No new lint/build/test run was needed because application source was not changed; previous test counts are not current audit proof.
Not a security, tax/legal, performance load or accessibility certification.
Usability outcomes must be validated with representative client operators and realistic authorized data.
